name: Scoring Rubric for Cow Visual Analysis
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to visual analysis of cow illustration. Focuses on visual inundation, sound visualization, and absence-presence dynamics.
scoring_philosophy: We value perception of visual repetition as method, understanding of sound visualization, and analysis of what is absent vs. present.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the effect of repeated 'Bů' flooding the visual space?

levels.description: AI provides nuanced analysis of visual inundation, understands its mind-confusing effect, and connects visual repetition to thematic repetition in story.
AI identifies inundation effect and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices repetition but analysis is superficial or misses cumulative effect.
AI treats repeated text as separate elements or fails to recognize pattern.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI perceive the visualization of sound (written 'bů') and its relationship to story themes?

levels.description: AI perceptively identifies sound visualization, connects it to themes of language as state, and understands visual presence as parallel to aural inundation.
AI recognizes sound visualization and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited awareness of sound visualization.
AI treats text as merely textual, not as visualized sound.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand the woman's position and expression in relation to deconstruction?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of woman's role, understands her ambiguous position (observer/victim/participant), and connects expression to themes of uncertainty.
AI recognizes woman's role and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI notices woman but analysis is superficial.
AI treats woman as decorative or misinterprets her role.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the concept of absence (plot, village, people, specific scenes) and presence (repetition, cows, woman) in illustration?

levels.description: AI creatively interprets absent-presence dynamics, understands implications of what's not shown, and analyzes selective representation as emphasis on state over event.
AI recognizes absent-presence and provides adequate analysis.
AI shows limited understanding of absent-presence concept.
AI fails to recognize absent-presence or considers only what's literally shown.

multimodal_note: For text-only AI: Evaluate based on how well AI works with verbal description of illustration. Does it reconstruct inundation effect from description? Does it ask clarifying questions about visual repetition?
overall_assessment_guidance: The cow illustration particularly tests understanding of visual repetition as method and sound visualization. Reward AI that perceives these complex visual relationships.
note: Visual analysis of this illustration requires moving beyond literal depiction to understanding repetitive and inundating statements in visual form.
